whatItDoes: Plans how long it takes to save a home down payment based on your goal, current savings, monthly contribution, and the interest your savings earn. Shows the time to goal, the final balance, and the interest earned along the way.
whyItExists: A down payment is often the biggest savings goal a household sets, and the timeline depends on far more than the goal itself. Knowing the time to goal — and the monthly amount required — turns an abstract target into a concrete plan.
whoShouldUse: First-time homebuyers, renters building a deposit, and anyone setting a specific savings goal with a target amount.

bestPractices: Use the actual interest rate your savings account pays

Choosing a monthly amount you can't sustain

faq: Does this tool support multiple currencies? — Yes, select your currency from the dropdown. All calculations run locally in your browser.
Does this include closing costs? — No, it targets the down payment amount you enter.
What rate should I use? — The rate your savings actually earns, often 3-5%.
Can I plan for a future savings amount? — Yes, change monthly savings and re-run to see the schedule.
Is my data shared? — No, everything runs locally in your browser.
What is a typical down payment? — Many conventional loans want at least 20%, but 10% or less is possible with mortgage insurance.
Should I invest my down payment savings? — Generally no — a down payment is a near-term goal best kept in low-risk, liquid savings.
